name: Model Left Full Body
shortDescription: Vietnamese model on the left, usually knee-up unless the full set needs a wider view; product matrix on the right.
promptNotes: Place a Vietnamese football model on the left side, preferably cropped from head to knees so the jersey is large and readable. Use a front-facing or three-quarter pose looking toward the camera; avoid the repeated side-profile pose looking left-to-right. Arrange front shirt, back shirt, and exactly one shorts view on the right. Keep title/SKU at the top and controls/contact at the bottom. Show exactly 3 collar options and no additional variants: Cổ tròn, Cổ Tim, Cổ polo.

name: Model Right Full Body
shortDescription: Vietnamese model on the right, usually knee-up unless the full set needs a wider view; product matrix on the left.
promptNotes: Place a Vietnamese football model on the right side, preferably cropped from head to knees so the jersey is large and readable. Arrange front shirt, back shirt, and exactly one shorts view on the left. Keep title/SKU at the top and controls/contact at the bottom. Show exactly 3 collar options and no additional variants: Cổ tròn, Cổ Tim, Cổ polo.

name: Model Left Portrait
shortDescription: Upper-body or three-quarter portrait model on the left, larger product surfaces on the right.
promptNotes: Place a Vietnamese football model as an upper-body, knee-up, or three-quarter portrait on the left, looking at the camera or in a slight three-quarter turn. Avoid the repeated side-profile pose looking left-to-right. Make the separate front shirt and back shirt larger on the right, with exactly one shorts view below them. Show exactly 3 collar options and no additional variants: Cổ tròn, Cổ Tim, Cổ polo.

name: Product Focus No Model
shortDescription: No human model; front, back, shorts, collar controls, and copy become the hero.
promptNotes: Do not include a human model. Make the separate front shirt, back shirt, and exactly one shorts view the main hero in a strong catalog grid. Use extra space for readable title, SKU, offer, collar selector, size selector, material line, feature badges, website, and hotline. Show exactly 3 collar options and no additional variants: Cổ tròn, Cổ Tim, Cổ polo.
